text.body: || śrīḥ || śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādapraṇītasarvamūsagranthāḥ tantrasārasaṅgrahaḥ|| śrīmaddhanumadbhimamadhvāntargatarāmakṛṣṇavedavyāsātmakaśrīlakṣmihayagrīvāya namaḥ || prathamo'dhyāyaḥ jayatyabjabhaveśendravanditaḥ kamalāpatiḥ | anantavibhavānandaśaktijñānādisaṅguṇaḥ || 1 || vidhiṃ vidhāya sargādau tena pṛṣṭo'bjalocanaḥ | āha devo ramotsaṅgavilasatpādapallavaḥ || 2 || ahameko'kilaguṇo vācakaḥ praṇavo mama | akārādyatiśāntantaḥ so'yamaṣṭākṣaro mataḥ || 3 || sa viśvataijasaprājñaturūyātmāntarātmanām | paramātmajñānātmayujāṃ madrūpāṇāṃ ca vācakaḥ || 4 || tadrūpabhedāḥ pañcaśanmūrtayo mama cāparāḥ | pañcāśadvarṇavācyāstā varṇāstārārṇabheditāḥ || 5 || dviraṣṭapañcakacatuḥpañcetyevāṣṭavargagāḥ | ajaḥ ānanda indreśānugra ūrja ṛtumbharaḥ || 6 || ṝghalṛśau lṝjiraikātmaira ojobhṛdaurasaḥ | anto'rdhagarbhaḥ kapilaḥ khapatirgaruḍāsanaḥ || 7 || gharmo ṅasāraścārvaṅgaśchandogamyo janārdanaḥ | jhāṭitārirñamaṣṭaṅkī ṭhalako ḍalako ḍharī || 8 || ṇātmā tārasthabho daṇḍī dhanvī namyaḥ paraḥ phalī | balī bhago manuryajño rāmo lakṣmīpatirvaraḥ || 9 || śāntasaṃvit ṣaḍguṇaśca sārātmā haṃsalālukau | pañcāśanmūrtayastvetā mamākārādilakṣakāḥ || 10 || nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣaraśca tārāṣṭākṣarabhedavān | ādyestāracatuvarṇairbhinna vyāhṛtayaḥ kramāt || 11 || aniruddhādikāstāsāṃ devatā vyutkrameṇa vā | tāścatumūrtayastveva dvādaśārṇapadoditāḥ || 12 || nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣarācca vyāhṛtibyastathaiva ca | vibhedo dvādaśārṇānāṃ keśavādyāśca devatāḥ || 13 || nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣarācca vyāhṛtitriguṇātpunaḥ | vedamātā tu gāyatrī dviguṇā dvādaśākṣarāt || 14 || caturviṃśanmūrtayo'syāḥ kathitā varṇadevatāḥ | tadbedaḥ pauruṣaṃ rūktaṃ vedāḥ puruṣasūktagāḥ || 15 || vaidikāssarvaśabdāśca tasmāt sarvābhidho'smyaham | pañcāśadvarṇabhinnāśca sarvaśabdā ato'pi ca || 16 || ṛṣiśca devataiko'haṃ tārādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ | chando madīyā gāyatrī tārāṣṭākṣarayormatā || 17 || udyadbhāsvātsamābhāsaścidānandaikadaihavān | cakraśaṅkhagadāpadmadharo dhyeyo'hamīśvaraḥ || 18 || lakṣmūdharābhyāmāśliṣṭaḥ svamūrtigaṇamadhyagaḥ | brahmavāyuśivāhīśavipaiḥ śakrādikairapi || 19 || sevyamāno'dhikaṃ bhaktyā nityaniḥśeṣaśaktimān | mūrtayo'ṣṭāvapi dhyeyāścakraśaṅkhavarābhayaiḥ | yuktāḥ pradīpavarṇāśca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 20 || tādṛgrūpāśca pañcāśajjñānamudrābhayodyatāḥ | ṭaṅkī daṇḍī ca dhanvī ca tattadyuktāstu vāmataḥ || 21 || vāsudevādikāḥ śuklaraktapītāsitojjavalāḥ | śaṅkhacakragadābjetaḥ prathamo musalī halī || 22 || saśaṅkhacakrastvaparastṛtīyaḥ śārṅgabāṇavān | saśaṅkhacakrasturyastu cakraśaṅkhāsicarmavān || 23 || keśavo madhurūdanaḥ sahkarṣaṇadāmodarau | savāsudevapradyumnā dakṣoccakaraśaṅkhinaḥ || 24 || viṣṇumādhavāniruddhapuruṣottamādhokṣajāḥ | janārdanaśca vāmoccakarasthitadarā matāḥ || 25 || govindaśca trivikramassaśrīdharahṛṣīkapāḥ | nṛsiṃhaścācyutaścaiva vāmādhaḥkaraśaṅkinaḥ || 26 || vāmanaḥ sanārāyaṇaḥ pagmanābha upendrakaḥ | hariḥ kṛṣmaśca dakṣādhaḥkare śaṅkhadharā matāḥ || 27 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāraścaite hi sarvaśaḥ | kramavyutkramapadmādigadādivyutkramastathā | ardhakramaḥ sāntaraśca ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsvaripūrviṇām || 28 || varṇānāṃ devatānāṃ ca nityatvānna kramaḥ svataḥ | vyaktikramaṃ brahmabuddhāvapekṣya krama ucyate || 29 || samāsavyāsayogena vyāhṛtīnāṃ catuṣṭayam | satyaṃ cāṅgāni tārasya procyante'ṣṭākṣarasya ca || 30 || kṛdvamahāvīradyulkasahasrahitolkakāḥ | caturthyantā hṛdādīni pṛthagrūpāṇi tāni ca || 31 || viṣṇorepātyabhede'pi tadaiścaryāttadanyavat | cakraśaṅkhavarābhītihastānyetāni sarvaśaḥ || 32 || mūlarūpasavarṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇā śikhocyate | caturviṃśanmūrtayaśca mūlarūpasavarṇakāḥ || 33 || ādivarṇatrayaṃ nābhihṛcchirassu yathākramam | nyasanīyaṃ ca tadvirṇadevetādhyānapūrvakam || 34 || pajjānunābhihṛdayavāṅnāsānetrakeṣu ca | aṣṭākṣaraṇāṃ nyāsaḥ syāt vyāhṛtīnāṃ prajāpatiḥ || 35 || muniścchandastu gāyatrī devatā bhagavān hariḥ | udyadādityavarṇaśca jñānamudrābhayodyataḥ || 36 || tāreṇa vyāhṛtībhisca jñeyānyaṅgāni pañca ca | nābhihṛtkeṣu sarveṣu catasro vyāhṛtīrnyaset || 37 || dvādaśārṇasya jagatī cchando'nyattāravatsmṛtam | acchavarṇo'bhayavarakaro dhyeyo'mitadyutiḥ || 38 || padairvyastaiḥ samastaiśca jñeyānyaṅgāni pañca ca | aṣṭākṣarāṇāṃ sthāneṣu bāhvorūrvośca vinyaset || 39 || viśvāmitrastu sandhyārthe tadanyatra prajāpatiḥ | munirdevastu savitṛnāmā sraṣṭatvato hariḥ || 40 || prodyadādityavarṇaśca sūryaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ | cakraśaṅkhadharo'ṅkasthadordvayo dhyeya eva ca || 41 || satārāśca vyāhṛtayo gāyatryaṅgāni pañca ca | doḥpatsandiṣu sāgreṣu nābhihṛnmukhakeṣu ca || 42 || varṇanyāsaśca kartavyastāravannakhilaṃ smṛtam | pañcāśadakṣarāṇāṃ ca puṃsūktasyāpi sarvaśaḥ || 43 || anuṣṭubhaśca triṣṭup ca jhando'sya triṣṭubho'pi vā | viṣṇuśabdaścaturthyantā hṛdayetaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 44 || tāravatsarvamasyāpi śyāmo dhyeyo hariḥ svayam | varṇā eva ṣaṅaṅgāni ṣaṇayorbhedayogataḥ || 45 || pajjānunābhihṛnnāsākeṣu nyāsaśca varṇaśaḥ | ete tu sarvamantrāṇāṃ mūlamantrā viśeṣataḥ || 46 || etajjñānātsamastaṃ ca jñātaṃ syācchavdagocaram | etajjapātsamastānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ jāpako bhavet || 47 || pūjyaśca bhagavānnityaṃ cakrābjādikamaṇḍale | hṛdaye vā cale vā'pi jale vā kevale sthale || 48 || aṣṭākṣareṇa sampūjya prathamaṃ devatāṃ parām | madhye savye gurūṃścaiva dakṣiṇe sarvadevatāḥ || 49 || punaḥ savye sarvagurūnāgneyādiṣu ca kramāt | garuḍaṃ vyāsadevaṃ ca durgāṃ caiva sarasvatīm || 50 || dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ caiva koṇagān | tadantaḥ pūrvādikpūrvamadharmādīṃśca pūjayet || 51 || apūjitā adharmādidātāraste tathā'bhidhāḥ | nirṛtiścaiva durgā ca kāmo rudraśca devatāḥ || 52 || yamavāyuśivendrāśca jñeyā dharmādidevatāḥ | paramaḥ puruṣo madhye śaktirādhārarūpiṇī || 53 || kūrmo'nantaśca pṛthivī kṣīrasāgara eva ca śvetadvīpo maṇaṭapaśca divyaratnamayo mahān || 54 || padmetattrayaṃ devī ramaiva bahurūpiṇī | sūryasomahutāśāśca padme śrīstriguṇātmikā || 55 || ātmāntarātmaparamajñānātmānaśca mūrtayaḥ | vimalotkarṣiṇī jñānā kriyā yogā tathaiva ca || 56 || prahvī satyā tatheśānā'nugrahā ceti śaktayaḥ | aṣṭadikṣu ca madhye ca svarūpāṇyeva tā hareḥ || 57 || tato'nantaṃ yogapīṭhasvarūpaṃ pūjayeddhareḥ | tatrāvāhya hariṃ cārghyaṃ pādyamācamanīyakam || 58 || madhuparkaṃ punaścācāṃ snānaṃ vāsaro vibhūṣaṇam | upavītāsane datvā gandhapuṣpe tathaiva ca || 59 || lakṣmīghare yajettatra pārśvayorubhayorhareḥ | hṛdayādīṃstathendrādidikṣvastraṃ koṇakeṣu ca || 60 || vāsudevādikān dikṣu keṣavādīṃstataḥ param | matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ varāhaṃ ca nārasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanam || 61 || bhārgavaṃ rāghavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ buddhaṃ kalkinameva ca | anantaṃ viśvarūpaṃ ca tadbahiḥ pūjayetkramāt || 62 || anantabrahmavāyvīśānvīśaṃ cāgre prapūjayet | vāruṇīṃ caiva gāyatrīṃ bhāratīṃ girijāmapi || 63 || koṇeṣu vīndravāme ca sauparṇīṃ pūjayedapi | indrādīn śeṣavidhyantān sabhāryān saparigrahān || 64 || dhūpadīpau tato datvā naivedyaṃ mūlamantrataḥ | anena kramayogena juhuyātsaṃskṛte'nale || 65 || puṣpāñjaliśca homaśca mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | sakṛtsakṛtpuṣpamanyairhomastasya caturguṇaḥ || 66 || visarjayitvā naivedyaṃ mūlena triḥ samarcya ca | dhūpadīpau punardatvā punarmūlena pūrvavat || 67 || arcayitvā punardhyātvā japeṭaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | purdhyāyeddhariṃ sarvadevadeveśvaraṃ prabhum || 68 || japadhyānahutārtādīnevaṃ yaḥ kurute sadā | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ bhājanaṃ syātsa eva hi || 69 || sarvettamaṃ hariṃ jñātvā ya evaṃ bhaktipūrvakam | japadhyānādibhirnityaṃ pūjayennāsya durlabham || 70 || bhaktiṃ kṛtvā'nyadeveṣu brahmarudrādikeṣvapi | sarvotkarṣamavijñāya viṣṇoryāti tamo dhruvam || 71 || na yajñā na ca tīrthāni nopavāsavratāni ca | daivatāni ca sarvāṇi trātuṃ taṃ śaknuyuḥ kvacit || 72 || harirhi sarvadevānāṃ paramaḥ pūrṇaśaktimān | svatantro'nye tadvaśā hi sarve'taḥ sa jagadguruḥ || 73 || brahmādayaśca tadbhaktyā bhāgino bhogamokṣayoḥ | tasmājjñeyaśca pūjyaśca vandyo dhyeyaḥ sadā hariḥ || 74 || || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracite tantrasārasaṅgrahe prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ yasya kasyāpi mantrasya nyāsaḥ pañcaśadakṣaraiḥ | vīryadaḥ ke'bhito vaktramakṣikarṇeṣu nāsayoḥ || 1 || gaṇḍayoroṣṭhayordantapaṅktyormūrdhani vāci ca | doḥpatsandhiṣu sāgreṣu pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhaguhyayoḥ || 2 || tunde ca hṛdi dhātūnāṃ saptake prāṇajīvayoḥ | sakṣakārān nyasedvarṇan nṛsiṃhaḥ kṣarasasya devatā || 3 || jape nyāse ca vihitaḥ kṣo'kṣarāṇāṃ sadā'ntataḥ | prāṇāyāmo recayitvā pūrayitvā ca kumbhake || 4 || tāraistridvādaśāvṛttairdvayekadvādaśakena vā | tattanmantreṇa vā kāryo gāyatryā daśatārakaiḥ || 5 || ādāveva jape kuryācchoṣaṇaṃ dahanaṃ plapatim | vāyvagnivāruṇairbījairdhyātvā tanmaṇḍale harim || 6 || ekapañcāśadvārṇānāṃ caturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ | ātmādyā vāsudevādyā viśvādyā mastyakacchapau || 7 || kolo nṛsiṃhaḥ savaṭirjāmadagnyaraghīdvahau | vāsiṣṭhayādavau kṛṣṇāvātreyo buddhakalkinau || 8 || śiṃśumāraśceti śataṃ kalāḥ kalaśanāmakāḥ | etābhiḥ sahitā mūlamūrtiṃ kumbhodake sudhīḥ || 9 || pūrvoktavidhinā'bhyarcya pratimāṃ śiṣyameva ca | snāpayetpūrvamarcāyāṃ japo'nūnaḥ sahasrataḥ || 10 || mūlamantrasya cāṅgānāṃ nyāsaḥ snānādanantaram | pratimāyāṃ sannidhikṛcchiṣye māhātmyakṛdbhavet || 11 || kalaśaḥ kīrtimāyuṣyaṃ prajñāṃ medhāṃ śriyaṃ balam | yogyatāṃ pāpahāniṃ ca puṇyavṛddhiṃ ca sādhayet || 12 || upasargeṣu jāteṣu daivabhūtātmahetuṣu | āyuṣe vā'tha śāntyai vā śriye vā puṇyavṛddhaye || 13 || yogyatāyai manatrasiddhayai viṣṇoḥ prītyarthameva vā | juhuyātsahasramayutaṃ lakṣaṃ koṭimathāpi vā || 14 || pūrvavatsaṃskṛte vahnau dhyātvā devaṃ janārdanam | kṛtvā trimekhalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ caturviṃśāṅgulocchritam || 15 || tāvatsvātaṃ catuṣkoṇamucchritaṃ dvādaśaiva vā | dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ vā'pi caturaṅgulameva vā || 16 || vistāro mekhalānāṃ syādantyā vā caturaṅgulā | caturviśāṅgulaṃ vā tadvistāro dvādaśaiva vā || 17 || aśvatthapatrākṛtiḥ syānmūlato dvādasāṅgulā | yoniḥ khāte ca vinatā praviṣṭā dvyaṅgulaṃ tathā || 18 || tadātmani hariṃ dhyātvā kuṇḍe devīṃ śriyaṃ tathā | viṣṇuvīryātmakaṃ bahniṃ nikṣipetpraṇavena hi || 19 || kuryātkriyāḥ ṣoḍaśa ca vyāhṛtībhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak | bahnestadgahareḥ prītiṃ kurvan dvavyairyajettataḥ || 20 || ājyena vā pāyasena samidbhiḥ kṣīriṇāmatha | kilairvā'tha taṇḍulairvā'pi madhuraistribhireva vā || 22 || brahmavṛkṣasamidbhirvā samidbhirvā'matodbhavaiḥ | amṛtāḥ samidho jñeyāḥ sarvatra caturaṅgalāḥ || 23 || evameva tu dīkṣāyāmājyenaivāhutikriyā | pūjā ca kāryā vidhivatpūrvaṃ sarvahuteṣvapi || 24 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāllakṣe lakṣe śataṃ sudhīḥ | ātmanaiva kṛte home śaktito gurudakṣiṇām || 25 || || iti śrīmadānandatīrathabagavatpādācāryaviracite tantrasārasaṅgrahe dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayan viṣṇoḥ kuryāt supratimāṃ budhaḥ | lohairvā śilayā dārvā mṛdā vā'pi yathākramam || 1 || ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulāṃ yoga āsīnāmathavā sthitām | śayānāṃ vā mumukṣūṇāṃ vyācakṣāṇāṃ nijāṃ sthitim || 2 || mukhādūrdhvaṃ dvyaṅguloccāṃ navāṅgulalasanmukhām | suvṛttatryaṅgulagrīvāmāstanācca ṣaḍaṅgulamām || 3 || pañcādasāṅgulāṃ nābherāsārdhadaśakāṅgulām | vṛṣaṇādāmūlataśca sārdhadvyaṅgulamāyatām || 4 || tāvadā gudato dīrghāṃ caityādāṣṭādaśāṅgulām | tatā dvyaṅgulacaityāṃ ca dvāviśajjahghayā yutām || 5 || ārabh‌ya gulphamadhyaṃca sahārdhacaturaṅgulām | ṣaḍaṅguloccaprapadāṃ sārdhadvyaṅgulameva ca || 6 || prapadoccayutāmante dvyaṅgulaprapadocchrayām | tryaṅguladvyaṅgulāmardhahīnamadhyāṅgulāmapi || 7 || tripadāṅgulahīnānyāṃ tatastādṛśatatparām | pādonoccāṅguṣṭhanakhāṃ tadardhatadanantarām || 8 || kramaśaḥ pādahīnānayāṃ raktapādanakhāṃ śubhām | vistāraḥ prapadasyāpi ṣaḍaṅgalu īritaḥ || 9 || aṅguṣṭhapariṇāhastu caturaṅgalaṃ īritaḥ | tryaṅgulaṃ tu tadanyasya vrīhyardhonāḥ kramāt parāḥ || 10 || daśāṅgulaṃ jaṅghamūlaṃ madhyaṃ tu tryahgulādhikam | saptādaśāṅgulaṃ tūrdhvaṃ jānuraṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ || 11 || ūrvanto'pi tathā jñeyo madhyaṃ dvirdvādaśāṅgulam | caturaṅgilādhikaṃ mūlaṃ guhyaṃ sārdhacatuṣṭayam || 12 || sārdhatrayaṃ parīṇāhādvṛṣaṇaṃ caturaṅgulam | saptāṅgulaṃ parīṇāhādvṛttaṃ proktaṃ samastaśaḥ || 13 || aṣṭatriṃśāṅgulaṃ kaṭyāḥ parīṇāha udāhṛtaḥ | suvṛttatvaṃ tathā śroṇyoḥ pīnatvaṃ ca samastaśaḥ || 14 || vistāraśca tathā kaṭyāḥ supratiṣṭhitatā padoḥ | kaṭyāścaivāṅgulādhikyaṃ nābheradha udāhṛtam || 15 || nābhiḥ sārdhāhgulascaiva gambhīro'rdhāhgulonnataḥ | vṛttaḥ pradakṣiṇaścaiva dvicatvāriṃśadaṅgulam || 16 || madhyaṃ stane parīṇāhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulamato'dhikaḥ | ekonaviṃśāṅgulaṃ tadurovistāralakṣaṇam || 17 || pādonamaṅgulaṃ caiva bhujābhyāṃ saha sārdhakam | aṃsayorvistṛtīścaiva pṛthagaṣṭāhgulā matā || 18 || saptāṅgulocchrayaḥ kakṣādupari skandhayormataḥ | aṣṭatriṃśāhgulañcaiva hastayormānamucyate || 19 || aṣṭādasāṅgulo bāhvoḥ pariṇāha udāhṛtaḥ | kramādūnaṃ tadante tu sārdhāṣṭāṅgulamīritam || 20 || sāṅgulasya talaḥ sārjhanavāṅgula udāhṛtaḥ | samaṃ tadubhayaṃ jñeyaṃ tathaiva talavistṛtiḥ || 21 || ardhāṅgulonnatā madhyā dvayoḥ sārdhāṅgulonnatā | kaniṣṭhikāyāstasyāstu vrīhimātrādhikaḥ paraḥ || 22 || sārdhatrayaparīṇāhau madhyajyeṣṭhāvudāhṛtau | anyau vrīhitadardhonāvanyā sārdhadvāyāṅgulā || 23 || pādonāntaparīṇāhāḥ sarve jyeṣṭāṃ vinā smṛtāḥ | vakṣovistārasagṛśaḥ pariṇāho galasya ca || 24 || lalāṭakukṣikaṇṭhāstu dīrgharekhātrayānvitāḥ | vṛtto galo bāhavaśca stanāvaṅgulayastathā || 25 || raktāstalanakhāścaiva netrānto'dhara eva ca | uttaroṣṭhasca jihvā ca nakhau pādonakāhgulau || 26 || ardhāṅgulau tathā madhyāvanye'ṣṭāṃśakramonakāḥ | nāsikāyā adhastācca nāsikā ca rarāṭikā || 27 || samā mānena nāsāyā uccatvenaiva māpane | ardhāṅgulādhikaṃ sarvaṃ mukhasya tu bhaviṣyati || 28 || caturaṅgulaṃ tathaivāsyaṃ sārdhavrīhyadharaṃ smṛtam | uttaraṃ vrīhimātraṃ tu tadūrdhvaṃ cādharopamam || 29 || sārdhāṅgulamadhaḥ proktamadharādadha eva ca | āsyāpārśvadvayaṃ proktamākarṇāttu ṣaḍaṅgulam || 30 || saptāṅgulaṃ nāsikāyāḥ pārśvamākarṇataḥ smṛtam | sapādāhgulamuccā ca nāsikā parīkīrtatā || 31 || ardhāṅgule puṭe tasyā madhyaṃ ca samudāhṛtam | nāsikā vrīhivistārā cakṣuṣī cāṅgulatraye || 32 || aṅgalaṃ caiva vistīrṇe phulle'rdhaṃ ca tadanyathā | caturaṅgulau bhnuvau caiva tathā'rdhāṅgulavistṛtau || 33 || asaṃhatau ca nibiḍau tathā pakṣma sunīlakam | karṇau ca tryahgulaṃ sārdhadvāyavistārasaṃyutau || 34 || sakuṇḍalaṃ tāvadeva vivaraṃ samprakīrtitam | tathā dvyaṅgulavistāro latābhyāṃ saha kathyate || 35 || karṇapūrayutau karṇāvutpalābhyāṃ ca saṃyutau | nīlālakasahasreṇa yuktaṃ tanmukhapaṅkajam || 36 || lalāṭaṃ suviśālaṃ ca tathā sārdhanavāṅgulam | vistārau mūrdhni vṛttaṃ ca śiraḥ chatrākṛti smṛtam || 37 || dīrghāśca kuñcitāgrāśca nīlāḥ keśā harermatāḥ | mukhamānena caivoccaṃ kirīṭaṃ keśavasya hi || 38 || kuṇḍale makarākāre vakṣaścaiva sakaustubham | saśrīvatsaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ pīnatuṅgumudāhṛtam || 39 || hāragraiveyasahitamupavītayutaṃ tathā | bāhavasca sakeyīrakaṅkaṇādamudrikāḥ || 40 || samadyabandhaṃ madhyaṃ ca nitambe pītamambaram | kāñcīguṇaśca padayornūpure cātisusvane || 41 || ahgulīyāni ca padoḥ kṛtibhiḥ sādhu kārayet | sottarīyaṃ ca cakrādyairāyudhaiśca samanvitam || 42 || anunnatairaviralairdantairyuktaṃ ca susmitam | samadṛṣṭiyutaṃ kāryaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ caiva manoharam || 43 || pratimārthaṃ vrajanpañcadhvanibhirmaṅgalairyutaḥ | gatvā śucisthalaṃ tatra śilāṃ caiva parikṣayet || 44 || dhvanibhedena vijñāya śilāṃ garbhavatīṃ tyajet | mūlamantraṃ japan viṣṇuṃ dhyāyaṃstiṣṭhedupoṣitaḥ || 45 || vārkṣī cedyajñavṛkṣasya sāreṇaiva tu kārayet | balidānaṃ ca saṅkṣepavidhānenaiva kathyate || 46 || asya saṅkṣepaśāstratvānna vistaravirodhitā | datvopahāraṃ haraye tadbhūtebhyo baliṃ haret || 47 || prācyebhyo viṣṇubhūtebhya ityādyakhiladikṣu ca | ādāya viṣṇubhūtebhyo lokapebhyastathā hareḥ || 48 || anujñāmudvared vṛkṣaṃ śilāṃ vā pratimākṛte | pratimāṃ piṇḍikāṃ pīṭhaṃ śilābhistu trijātibhiḥ || 49 || svarasthūlatvabhedena puṃstryādyā jātibhiḥ śilāḥ | puṃśilāṃ pratimārthaṃ tu strīśilāṃ pīṭhaklṛptaye || 50 || vedamahgalaghoṣeṇa vādyaistatpratimāṃ haret | prāgudakpravaṇe deśe kuryāddevālayaṃ sudhīḥ || 51 || rāmāvṛte dakṣiṇataḥ paśṭādgiryagra eva va | madye vā grāmapurayorviśāle suśucau tathā || 52 || aiśānīṃ diśamekāṃ tu vinodakavivarjite | jalāśayasya madhye vā śilāvṛkṣādivarjite || 53 || śmāśānādikadeśānāṃ vidūre sumānohare | kiṣkudvādaśato'nunaṃ kuryāddevāsayasthalam || 54 || dviguṇaṃ caturguṇaṃ vāpi śatakiṣkupramāmakam | kṛtvā bhūśodhanaṃ samyak sārdhapuṃmānatstvadhaḥ || 55 || keśāṅgārāsthivalmīkaloṣṭāśmādivirjite | hariṃ tatrāpi sampūjya baliṃ datvā ca pūrvavat || 56 || mṛddāruśailairlohairvā kuryāddevālayaṃ dṛḍham | dīrghāśca kalamāstisrastiryagaṣṭayavodarāḥ || 57 || aṅgulyā madhyarekhāyāḥ samā lakṣaṇataḥ smṛtāḥ | svāṅgulyā madhyarekhā tu pratimādiṣu lakṣaṇam || 58 || hrasvamadhyoccabhedena tattanmānaṃ samastaśaḥ | prādeśahastapuruṣamānaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam || 59 || pratimādhyarthakaṃ dvāramūrdhvamadhyaṃ ca vistṛtiḥ | pratimārdhapramāṇena pīṭhāsyoccatvamiṣyate || 60 || unnatiḥ piṇḍikāyāstu caturaṅgulamānataḥ | tryaṅgulaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ vā'pi gṛhāntaḥpratimāsamam || 61 || uccaṃ paryak ca kramaśa uccatvaṃ madhyataḥ smṛtam | tāvaduccaṃ bahiścaiva yadyekaśikharaṃ bhavet || 62 || ardhoccamathavā'pi syādadhastāt pratimonnatam | tato dviguṇamānaṃ vā sārdhapratimameva vā || 63 || śikharāntare tu pratimāmānaṃ tadgala ucyate | tattripādaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadadhyardhamathāpi vā || 64 || vartulaṃ padmasadṛśaṃ hastipṛṣṭhasamaṃ tathā | caturasraṃ cāṣṭakoṇaṃ vimānaṃ parikīrtikam || 65 || pratimāyā daśaguṇaṃ viṃśadguṇamathāpi vā | vartulaṃ śikharaṃ tvekaṃ kirīṭākṛtimadbhavet || 66 || sabhayā'pi sametaṃ vā pṛthakalabhamathāpi vā | dvisabhaṃ trisabhaṃ vāpi sagopuramathāpi vā || 67 || prakāravṛttayuktaṃ vā saptaprakārameva vā | sahmavṛttaṃ kiṣkumātraṃ bahirvā caturasrakam || 68 || tataḥ paraṃ kiṣkumātraṃ sabhāyā antaraṃ yadi | tatastāvattṛtīyāyāḥ sārdhameva hyudāhṛtam || 69 || kiṣkutrakaṃ ca śakrādeḥ sthānaṃ tadvṛttataḥ smṛtam | tatastu maṇṭapaṃ kuryātpratiṣṭāyāḥ sulakṣaṇam || 70 || pūjayedvāstupuruṣasyoparisthāṃstu sarvadā | devān brahmādikān vāsturvarāhasya hareḥ sutaḥ || 71 || pātito daivatairbhūmau caturasrākṛtiḥ sthitaḥ | kṛtvā'ṣṭakāṣṭakoṣṭāni madhye brahmā catuṣṭaye || 72 || pūjyo dvaye dvaye śakro yame varuṇa eva ca | somaśca pūjyāḥ koṇeṣu vahnyādyāḥ koṇadevatāḥ || 73 || punastrayo traye kāmaṃ dhātāraṃ savidhātṛkam | skandaṃ ca pūjayetkoṇe sūryaṃ caiva vināyakam || 74 || kālaṃ kuberaṃ ca bahiḥ pratyekaṃ dikṣu pūjayet | hāriṃ hariṃ gabhīraṃ ca gāhanaṃ gahanaṃ guham || 75 || bhānumaṅgārakaṃ caiva pūrvasyāṃ diśi pūjayet | dārumaṃ vidariṃ dyotaṃ pradyotaṃ dyotanaṃ hiram || 76 || mṛtyuṃ śanaiśvaraṃ caiva dakṣiṇasyāṃ prapūjayet | puṣkaraṃ kṣaraṇaṃ kṣāriṃ vikṣaṇaṃ kṣobhaṇaṃ kṣaṇam || 77 || cārvaṅgaṃ bhārgavaṃ caiva paścimāyāṃ prapūjayet | cāraṃ vicāraṃ pracaraṃ sañcāraṃ caraṇaṃ caram || 78 || bṛhaspatiṃ budhaṃ caivāpyuttarasyāṃ prapūjayet | evameva vimānasya kṛteḥ prāgapi pūjayet || 79 || saptaparṇamayaṃ sādhu karayenmaṇ‍ḍapaṃ tataḥ | saptahastaṃ dviṣaḍḍhastamathavā dviguṇaṃ tataḥ || 80 || caturguṇaṃ vā samyak tu caturasraṃ saṃhājiram | anyacca maṇṭapaṃ dīrghaṃ pañcahastaṃ tu kārayet || 81 || tricatuṣkoṣṭhakaṃ tatra madhye prāgāyataṃ śubham | kārayenmaṇḍalaṃ sādhu hastamātraṃ tu vistṛtam || 82 || tatra dvādaśapātrāṇi sthāpayetpālikādikam | pālikāstu caturviṃśatyaṅgulocchrayasaṃyutāḥ || 83 || aṣṭādaśāṅgulāścaiva tathā pañcamukhā iti | dvādaśāṅgulakāścaiva śarāvāḥ paścimānugāḥ || 84 || tatra viṣṇuṃ caturmūrtiṃ pūjayedbhaktitastriśaḥ | saptadhānyāni teṣaaveva pūrayedaṅkurārthataḥ || 85 || tatra nityaṃ baliṃ dadyādviṣaaṇave daśarātrakam | brahmaśaṅkaragīrvāṇapitṛgandharvayakṣakaiḥ || 86 || bhūtaiśca pāyasenaiva tathā padmākṣatena ca | annāpūpena puṣpānnairannalājākṣatairapi | saktubhiśca krameṇaiva devāntaṃ pāyasena vā || 87 || tadaiva pratimāyāśca kārayedadhivāsanam | pañcagavye saptarātraṃ kṣiptvā puruṣasūktataḥ || 88 || vedāṃśca caturaḥ samyak pārayeyurdvijottamāḥ | pracyādidvāragau dvau dvāvekaikaṃ tu daśāvarāḥ | yathālabdhaṃ yathāvittamathavā viṣṇutatparāḥ || 89 || trayodaśātra kuṇḍāni paritaḥ kārayedbudhaḥ | uktalakṣaṇayuktāni pradhānaṃ tvagnikoṇake | sākṣāttu koṇagāddhastamātramantarataḥ sudhīḥ || 90 || ājyāhutiṃ teṣu kuryāt pratyekaṃ lakṣasaṅkhyayā | pratyekamayutaṃ vā'pi pradhāne lakṣasaṅkhyakam || 91 || ardhaṃ tadardhamathavā mūlamantreṇa mantravit | pañcaviṃśatitatvārthe pradhāne juhuyāt puraḥ || 92 || pratyekaṃ tu sahasraṃ vā pratyekaṃ śatameva vā | śataṃ puruṣasūktena gāyatryā ca sahasrakam | kṛtvā jalādhivāsaṃ ca pūrvaṃ vā pañcagavyataḥ || 93 || cakrābjaṃ bhadrakaṃ vā'pi maṇṭape maṇḍalaṃ śubham | padmaṃ vṛttatrayaṃ cakraṃ rāśayo vīthikā tathā || 94 || śobhopaśobhikāścaiva cakrābjasya tu lakṣaṇam | caturasraṃ vinā cakraṃ viśeṣo bhadrake smṛtaḥ || 95 || sahasramardhaṃ pādaṃ vā kalaśāṃstatra pūjayet | śataṃ tadardhaṃ pādaṃ vā vittābhāve nigadyate || 96 || kvāthena kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ tathā pañcāmṛtairapi | pañcagavyena śuddhena jalena ca pṛthak pṛthak || 97 || pūrayetkalaśānmadhyaṃ śuddhodenaiva pūrayet | brāhmasyaiva caturhikṣu gandhodānāṃ catuṣṭayam || 98 || caturdale site padmacatuṣke maṇḍale sthite | pūrvādikramayogena rasakvāthaśubhodakān || 99 || gandhāṃśca sthāpayetpañcagavyaṃ śuddhāntare nyaset | pṛthak caturdalaṃ padmaṃ raktaṃ kṛtvā'lpakaṃ sudhīḥ || 100 || pañcaśatve tu gandhodaṃ sarvamadhye nidhāpayet | brāhmasya purastvekaṃ śārvaṃ saṃsthapayedbṛhat || 101 || aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭapadmeṣu pañcakaṃ pañcakaṃ nyaset | anena kramayogena kalaśā akhilā api || 102 || tattaddravyamayāstatra tatra sthāpyastuṃ bāhyataḥ | tadaivāṅkurapātrāṇi paritastatra vinyaset || 103 || kuśodakaṃ ca kārpūraṃ kauṅkumaṃ cāndanaṃ tathā | tuhinodaṃ haridrodamauśīraṃ koṣṭhasārṣapam || 104 || nadīsaṅgamajaṃ caiva tāḍākaṃ kaupyameva vā | nirjharodamiti proktā viśeśakalaśāstvime | śuddhodadvayamapyetanmahātīrthasamudbhavam || 105 || caturviṃśatimūrtināṃ varṇamūrtiṃsthā'parāḥ | āvāhayeccatatve tu kramavyutkramatastu tāḥ || 106 || varṇamūrtīḥ punaścaiva dvicaturvārameva ca | sahasrakalaśāditve japenmantrāṃśca śaktitaḥ || 107 || tatastu pañcaghoṣaiśca vedaghoṣastathā''darāt | ānīya pratimāṃ snānaṃ kārayetpraṇavena tu || 108 || mantraiḥ puruṣasūktāntaiḥ viśvataścakṣuṣā tathā | punaścāṣṭākṣareṇaiva praṇavena ca bhaktitaḥ || 109 || snāpayitvā gandhajalairgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ punaḥ | alaṅkṛtya sthāpayettu pratimāṃ praṇavena tu || 110 || japedaṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ tattanmūrtimanuṃ tathā | aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantrī dhyāyettejomayīṃ punaḥ || 111 || pratimāṃ pratimāntasthāṃ tanmadhye paramaṃ vapuḥ | cidānandarasaṃ pūrṇaguṇasampūrṇamuttamam || 112 || pañcaviṃśatitattvānāṃ devatāstadanantaram | s‌thāpayet pratimāmadhye paritaḥ keśavasya tu || 113 || tatrātvāhārṣasūktaṃ ca gharmasūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam | sūktaṃ ca viśvakarmīyaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 114 || japtvā caiva nijaṃ mantraṃ punaraṣṭākṣaraṃ sudhīḥ | praṇavaṃ ca japedviṣṇuṃ dhyāyannuttamarūpiṇam || 115 || tatastu kalaśairbāhyakrameṇaiva janārdanam | snāpayeduktamantraistu madhyamaṃ praṇavena tu || 116 || aṣṭārṇena nijenāpi tathā puruṣasūktataḥ | āvahanaṃ ca snapanaṃ pañcagavyena madhyavat | pūrvādyuttaraparyantaḥ kalaśakrama ucyate || 117 || japtvā punaśca tanmantrān pūjayecca vidhānataḥ | dvāralokapatibhyaśca baliṃ datvā yathākramam || 118 || vastraratnahiraṇyodyailaṅkṛtya vibhūtitaḥ | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātkoṭiṃ lakṣaṃ sahasrakam || 119 || śatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā niḥsvo bhaktyā kṣamāpayet | tadardhamṛtvijāṃ caiva tadardhaṃ pāraṇākṛtām || 120 || āśvabhya āśvapākebhyo dadyādannaṃ samastaśaḥ | purastātparataścaiva saptarātraṃ nirantaram || 121 || suvarṇavastraratnādyairāgatābhyāgatānapi | pūjayecchaktito bhaktyā prīyatāṃ bhagavaniti || 122 || gītanṛtyaiśca vādyaiśca purāṇairitihāsakaiḥ | sūktairmaṅgalaghoṣaiśca vaidikairdinasaptakam || 123 || nayettato mahārājavibhūtyā'vabhṛthaṃ sudhīḥ | kārayeddevadevasya svādhyāyairgitanṛttakaiḥ || 124 || mahānadīsahgame tu tīrthe cātipraśastake | snāpayetpūrvavanmantraiḥ puṃsūkaktāntaiḥ smaran harim || 125 || tataḥ pūrvavadāgatya praveśya puruṣottamam | pūjayitvā vidhānena datvā dānāni śaktitaḥ || 126 || guraṃ ca bhaktyā sampūjya svīkuryādiśiṣastataḥ | śataprastādanūnaṃ tu naivedyaṃ pyasottaram || 127 || dineṣveteṣu dātavyaṃ saghṛtaṃ sasitādikam | paścādapi yāthāśakti pūjā kāryā hareḥ sadā || 128 || jīrṇālayoddhṛtau caiva tattvamantrān svakaṃ tathā | pratilomena japtvaiva mūrtau saṅkocayeddharim || 129 || uktenaiva vidhānena tadardhavibhavaiḥ sudhīḥ | pādamātrairapi hariṃ snāpayitvā yatheditam || 130 || etenaiva vidhānena kṛtvā devālayaṃ punaḥ | snāpayetpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ dviguṇena pravāhaṇāt || 131 || vibhavenānulomena jupenmantrān punastathā | ārādhayejjagannāthaṃ dhyāyan bhaktyā yathoditam || 132 || yātrā'pi pūrvavattatrāpayutsaveṣu ca sarvaśaḥ | kalaśoktavidhānena pūjā balihṛtistathā || 133 || utsaveṣu sadā kāryā kalaśaścotsavādanu | yātrā snānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ samyaguktavidhānanaḥ || 134 || coracaṇḍālapatitaśvodakyādipraveśane | śavādyupahatau caiva pūjāvicchedane tathā || 135 || snapanoktena mārgeṇa prayaścittakṛtiḥ smṛtāḥ | sarvatra viṣṇugāyatryā homaḥ syādayutāvaraḥ || 136 || nāvāvyādyabhidhānānu vidmahe dhīmahe tathā | pracodayāttṛtīyādhastanno gāyatrināmikā || 137 || durgāśivaskandasūryavināyakamukhānapi | sthāpayeduktamārgeṇa tattanmantraiḥ smaran harim || 138 || golakadvitayaṃ viṣṇostritayaṃ vā'pi kīrtitam | anyadevapratiṣṭhāsu tadantaścintayeddharim || 139 || viṣṇusmṛtivihīnā tu pūjā syādāsurī tathā | gṛhṇanti devatā naitāṃ tataḥ syāddeśaviplavaḥ | vayādhicorādibhistasmādantardhyeyo hariḥ sadā || 140 || viṣṇubhaktivihīnasya gatiḥ syānna śubhā kvacit | bhaktasyāpyanyadeveṣu tasmāddhyeyo hariḥ sadā || 141 || saṃsmṛto bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalaḥ | samastābhūṣṭadāyī syāttena dhyeyo'khilairjanaiḥ || 142 || puruṣo'vyaktaṃ ca mahānahaṅkāro manastathā | daśendriyāṇi śabdādyā bhūtetāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 143 || tattvākhyāḥ kālamāye ca niyatirmatireva ca | vidyā kalā pravṛtiśca dvātriṃśattattvasaṅgrahaḥ || 144 || sphūrttiḥ saṃvitpratiṣṭhā ca śaktirityaparāṇi ca | mahālakṣmīsvarūpāṇi hyekādaśa vido viduḥ | viṣṇorapi hi rūpāṇi tannāmnaikādaśaiva tu || 145 || pradhānopamavarṇāni dvibhujānyapyaśeṣataḥ | kṛtāñjalipṛṭānyeva pradhānaṃ taṃ hariṃ prati || 146 || sarvaṇyetāni tattvāni brahmā tu puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ | mahāṃścāvyaktanānmī tu brahmāṇī samprakīrtitā || 147 || evaṃ vāyurapi jñeyo bhāratī cāpi tattrayam | rudro'haṅkāra uddiṣṭaḥ skandendrau mana ucyate || 148 || ahaṅkāraḥ śeṣavīndrāvapi vidvadbhirīritau | digvāyusūnusūryāśca varuṇascāścināvapi || 149 || vahnidakṣāvindrasūnurmitraścaiva manustathā | indriyākhyāḥ śabdanāmā bṛhaspatirudāhṛtaḥ || 150 || anye tu sūnavo vāyo rudrasyāpi prakīrtitāḥ | eteṣu bhagavān viṣṇuḥ pradhānatanureva tu || 151 || dhyeyaḥ parātmanormadhye tattvanāma tadarthayoḥ | jape nyāse namoṃ'ntastu svāhānto homakarmaṇi || 152 || tricatuḥ ṣaṭdaśāvṛttireteṣāṃ tu hutādike | nyāso'ṅgulīṣūrubāhumadhyeṣu vyutkrame smṛtaḥ | krame viparyayeṇātra śaktyāditvaṃ prakīrtitam || 153 || ṛṣicchandodevatāṅgadhyānānuktau pradhānavat | jñeyā mantrāḥ samastāste pṛthaṅmokṣādidāyakāḥ || 154 || tantramārgāstu hariṇā hyasaṅkhyāḥ kīrtitā api | teṣvayaṃ sugamo mārgaḥ saphalaścānutiṣṭhatām || 155 || yāvato hyananuṣṭhāne karmapūrtirna vidyate | tāvat samastaṃ kathitaṃ hyasmiṃstantre yathāvidhi || 156 || prīyate'nena mārgeṇa pūjito muktido bhavet | kāmadaśca svabhaktānāṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ || 157 || || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracite tantrasārasaṅgrahe tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || caturtho'dhyāyaḥ atha viṣṇūdite tantrasāre mantragaṇo hi yaḥ | uditaḥ saṅgraheṇāsāvucyate' khilasādhanaḥ || 1 || yāṣṭamastūyuto'ntena sametaścaiva bhūbhṛtaḥ | bījaṃ namaśca bhagavān soddeśyo rūpasaṃyutaḥ || 2 || sa eva tādṛśo lokatrayapālo bhuvaḥ pateḥ | bāvaṃ me dehi dānte tu dāpaya svāhayā yutaḥ || 3 || manustasyāpararastārabījoddeśanamoyutaḥ | namaḥ soddeśabhagavān mahāśabdayutaśca saḥ | tādṛśaḥ svāhayā yukto varāhasyāparo manuḥ || 4 || śyāmaḥ sudaraśanadarābhayadvareto bhūmyā yuto'khilanijoktaparigrahaiśca | dhyeyo nijaiśca tanubhiḥ sakalairupetaḥ kolo hariḥ kakalavāñchitasiddhaye'dajaḥ || vaiṣmavānāṃ munirbrahmā mantrāmāṃ varṇabhedataḥ | jñeyaṃ chando devataikastattadrūpo hariḥ paraḥ || 6 || praṇavena svanāmnā ca bhūdhareṇa parātmanā | sarvajñasarvaśaktibhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni vido viduḥ || 7 || jñānaiśvaryaprabhānandatejaḥśaktibhireva vā | pūrṇātmamadhyagaiḥ sarvavaiṣṇavāṅgānyatho viduḥ || 8 || tiṣṭodādisvajāyāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ svāhayā yutaḥ | śrīkaro'ṣṭākṣaro mantro garuḍāruḍhasaṃsmṛtiḥ || 9 || dvirbhiṣaya trāsaya ca pramardaya tathaiva ca | pradhvaṃsayātho rakṣeti pañcāṅgāścetyudāhṛtaḥ || 10 || prūraṃ vīraṃ bṛhadviṣṇuṃ dīpyantaṃ viśvatomukham | puṃmṛgendraṃ bhayakaraṃ śubhaṃ mṛtyośca mārakam | namāmi svayamityeṣa dvātriṃśārṇo manurhareḥ || 11 || dvirjayasyopari nijaṃ soddeṣaṃ sarvavittathā | mahātejo balaṃ vīryaṃ tādṛśaṃ svāhayā yutam | caturviṃśākṣaro mantro nikhileṣṭapradāyakaḥ || 12 || vidmahe dhīmahe pūrvaṃ svayaṃ caiva mahābalaḥ | prerayettanna ityetanmadhye'nantaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 13 || pādairvyastaiḥ samastaiśca padaiścaiṅgaṃ prakīrtitam | pūrvayostatra pūrvaṃ tu sarvajñena ṣaḍaṅkam | tṛtīyaṃ tu dvirāvṛttaiḥ pādairaṅgāsamanvitam || 14 || dhyāyennṛsiṃhamuruvṛttaravitrinetraṃ jānaprasaktarakayugmamathāparābhyām | takraṃ daraṃ ca dadhataṃ priyayā sametaṃ tigmāṃśukoṭyadhikatejasamagyraśaktim||15|| sarveṣvapi hi mantreṣu dvyādyanantāntabāhukaḥ | cetanāntasthamārabhya sarvāgāntastharūpavān || 16 || anantarūpo dhyeyo'tra svagurūktānusārataḥ | yathāyogyaṃ yathāśakti tattadāyudhabhūṣaṇaḥ || 17 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmakhaḍgakheṭāḥ saśārṅgakāḥ | śaro mukalavadrau ca halaḥ pāśāṅkuśau tathā || 18 || śūlaṃ ca bhiṇḍipālaśca paṭṭaśo'gnirvarābhaye | tarkamudrā'kṣamālā ca pustarakaṃ ca vidāraṇam | ityādīnyakhilānyeva viṣṇościntyāni bāhuṣu || 19 || viyatsa iti yugmārṇo viparītaśca sa smṛtaḥ | sa sargahīno vetaśca binduhīnottarastathā || 20 || traya ete mahāmantraḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye | kalpavṛkṣāḥ priyā viṣṇorviśeṣajñānadāyakāḥ || 21 || taireva tu dvirāvṛttairaṅgameṣāṃ prakīrtitam | śvāsarūpo japo nityamubhayorvidvadajñayoḥ || 22 || ekaviṃśatsahasrātmā saṣaṭśatamaharniśam | arpaṇīyo harau nityaṃ prātaryogo mahānayam || 23 || aśeṣadoṣadahanastattvajñānapradāyakaḥ | aṣṭaiśvaryapradaścaiva kṛtādau samupāsatām | tārayogo'pyevameva brahmādāveva vartate || 24 || dhyāyedravīndrukaramindusahasralakṣakāntiṃ priyāsahitamāsthitamindubimbe| śaṅkhāridordvayamudarkamahendubimbāt saṃsicyamānamamṛtena ramādhinātham ||25|| antyasya raktavarṇo vā dhyeyo viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ | vidyudvarṇo'thavā dhyeyaḥ śaktyetaḥ pañcamantrayuk || 26 || aṣṭākṣaro mahāmantraḥ tairevāṅgaiḥ samanvitaḥ | antyadhyānayutaścaiva niḥśeṣapuruṣārthadaḥ || 27 || mūlaṃ naḥ pritaṣedhaśca soddeśo bhagavānapi | viṣṇurbhojyādhipaḥ svāhāyukto'ṣṭādaśavarṇakaḥ || 28 || aṅgāni tatpadaireva mantracintāmaṇiḥ svayam | yatheṣṭabhakṣabhojyādidātā muktipradāyakaḥ || 29 || dhyāyetsuśuklamaravindadalāyatākṣaṃ sauvarṇapātradadhibhojyamathāmṛtaṃ ca | dorbhyāṃ dadhānamakhilaiśca suraiḥ sametaṃ śītāṃśumaṇḍalagataṃ ramayā sametam||30|| amṛtaṃ svayamuddeśayuktaḥ sahṛdayo manuḥ | satāro'ṣṭākṣaro'ṅgāni padairvyastaiḥ samastakaiḥ || 31 || udyadraviprabhamarīndradarau gadāṃ ca jñānaṃ ca bibhratamajaṃ priyayā sametam | viśvāvakāśamabhitaḥ pratibhāsayantaṃ bhāsā svayā smarata viṣṇumajādivandyam || 32 || trivikramaśca soddeśo viśvarūpaśca tatparaḥ | dhīvidau ca mahe viṣṇustannaḥ preraṇamadhyagaḥ || 33 || svayamuddeśasaṃyuktaḥ tadādyarṇapuraḥ saraḥ | sanatiḥ ṣaḍakṣaro mantro varṇairaṅgakriyā matā || 34 || aṅgāravarṇamabhito'ṇḍabahiḥprabhābhirvyāptaṃ paraśvadhadhanurdharamekavīram | dhyāyedajeśapuruhūtamukhaistuvadbhirāvītamātmapadavīṃ pratipādayantam || 35 || śyāmaṃ ravīndramitadīdhitikāntiyuktaṃ jñānaṃ śaraṃ ca dadhataṃ priyayā sametam | svātmasvarūpamamitaṃ hanumanmukheṣu sandarśayantamajitaṃ smaratorugīrbhiḥ || 36|| nijāgotraṃ tu soddeśaṃ pūrvākṣarapuraḥ saram | natyantaṃ tārapūrvaṃ ca manuraṣṭākṣaro mataḥ || 37 || te ca bīje bījabhūte dharmādīnāmaśeṣataḥ | eta vijayadā mantrā jñānamokṣapradāyakāḥ | hiraṇyatnarājyādisamabhīṣṭasuradrumāḥ || 38 || kṛṣṇo govicca kāmetaḥ soddeśo ballavījanaḥ | priyaśca tādṛśasvahāyukto'ṣṭādaśavarṇakaḥ | padairaṅgāni samprītikāmamokṣaprado manuḥ || 39 || dhyāyeddharinmaṇinibhaṃ jagadekavandyaṃ saundaryasāramariśaṅkhavarābhayāni | dorbhirdadhānamajitaṃ sarasaṃ ca bhauṣmīyatyasametamakhisapradamindireśam || 40 || sakāmaḥ svayamuddeśī natyanto'yaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | tadādirapi sarveṣṭacintāmaṇirudāhṛtaḥ || 41 || dṛṣṭārtha eva mantrāṇāṃ kalau vīryaṃ tiraskṛtam | tatrāpyuddīptavīryā hi mantrā atra prakīrtitāḥ | vāsiṣṭhavṛṣṇipravaramantrāstatrāpi vīryadāḥ || 42 || svayaṃ vedapadārūḍhaḥ pūrvarṇapuraḥsaraḥ | natyanto'ṣṭākṣaro mantraḥ priyo vijñānagopateḥ || 43 || vyākhyāśrisarvavijñānakavitādiguṇapradaḥ | vāde vijayado nityaṃ yathā yuddhe nṛkesarī || 44 || vijñānarociḥ paripūritāntarbāhyāṇḍakośaṃ haritopalābham | tarkābhayetaṃ vidhiśarvapūrvagīrvāṇavijñānadamānato'smi || 45 || jñānānandapuraḥpūrṇo vidmahe dhīmahe tathā | tannaḥ preraṇamadhye tu vyāso mantrādhipādhipaḥ || 46 || ādibījaṃ sthirādoṣajñānabījaṃ vimuktidam | sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 47 || dhyāyecchāśāṅkaśatakoṭyatisaukhyakāntiṃ saṃsicyamānamamṛtorughaṭaiḥ sureśaiḥ | varṇābhimānibhirajeśamukhaiḥ sahaiva pañcāśatā pratigirantamaśeṣavidyāḥ || 48 || soddaiśastu svayaṃ dīrghapūrvādyārṇo namoyutaḥ | sarvavidyāprado'ṣṭārṇaḥ prativādiyapradaḥ | vimuktisādhanaḥ kīrtibuddhisthairyapradaḥ sadā || 49 || vande turaṅgavadanaṃ śaśibimbasaṃsthaṃ candrāvadātamamitātmakaraiḥ samantāt| aṇḍāntaraṃ bahirapi pratibhāsayantaṃ śaṅkākṣapustakasubodhayutābjabāhum || 50|| nasto mukhādapi nirantaramudgirantaṃ vidyāaśeṣata utābjabhaveśamukhyaiḥ | saṃsevyamānamatibaktibharāvanmairlakṣmyā'mṛtena satataṃ pariṣicyamānam || 51 || svayamuddeśavānpūrvavarṇapūrvo namoyutaḥ | satāro'ṣṭākṣaraścaiva navārṇaśca manū smṛtau || 52 || prodyaddivākarasamānatanuṃ sahasrasūryorudīdhitibhirāptasamastalokam | jñānābhayāṅkitakaraṃ kapilaṃ ca dattaṃ dhyāyedajādisamitaṃ prati bodhayantam || 53|| adhṛṣyatājñānamokṣapradau bhakteṣvimau sadā | sūktaṃ dīrghatamodṛṣṭaṃ `viṣṇornu kam' iti prabhoḥ || 54 || sarvārthadaṃ gārtsamadaṃ `yo jāta' iti cāparam | vāsiṣṭaṃ ca paro mātrayeti jñānavimuktidam || 55 || bhauvanīyaṃ sarvakāmamokṣadaṃ ya imetyapi | evamevākhilā vedā jñātavyā viṣṇutatparāḥ || 56 || svadṛṣṭaṃ sūktamakhilaṃ kāmadaṃ harituṣṭidam | vāco'mbhṛṇyāḥ śriyo'ṅgāni śrīrlakṣmīrmendirā ramā || 57 || kauśeyapītavasanāmaravindanetrāṃ padmadvayābhayavarodyatapadmahastām | udyacchatārkasadṛśīṃ paramāṅkasaṃsthāṃ dhyāyedvidhīśanutapādayugāṃjanitrīm || 58 || lajjābījaṃ ca tadbījaṃ tasyā evābhidhāyakam | pāśāṅkuśau raktavastre lajjābīje viśiṣyate || 59 || amadhyayugmasvaharagatainaivāṅgamudāhṛtam | sattābūjaṃ ca durbījaṃ tadvadeva prakīrtitam || 60 || varṇaḥ śyāmo viśeṣo'tra tāmbūlaṃ nīlamutpalam | śaṅkhacakrau tarjanaśca śūlamityaparatra ca || 61 || namo'ntaṃ svena sahitastadevānyo manuḥ smṛtaḥ | durgā triṣṭup kaśyapoktā tatra varṇo'gnivat smṛtaḥ || 62 || trinetratvaṃ ca durgāyāḥ prāyaḥ sarvatra kathyate | pādaiḥ samastena tathā ṣaḍvarmenāṅgamucyate || 63 || ramāyā eva rūpāṇi tvetāni hi vido viduḥ | mukhyāto jāmadagnyastu devātā'sya manoḥ smṛtaḥ || 64 || hiraṇyagarbhasūktaṃ ca bhṛgudṛṣṭaṃ prakīrtitam | brahmadhātṛviriñcājapādmairaṅgamudāhṛtam || 65 || dhyāyenniṣaṇṇamajamacyutanābhipadme proddivākarasamūhanikāśamagyram | mātṛprakārakaramuttamakāntitadbhirvaktraiḥ sṛntamakhilaiḥ paramārthavidyāḥ || 66 || svayamuddeśanatimāstasya pañṭākṣaro manuḥ | svayamevāparo'ṣṭārmastādṛśaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ || 67 || balādyaṃ bhṛdumā dṛṣṭaṃ prāṇāgneḥ sūktamucyate | prāṇādyaiḥ pañcabhistasyāpyaṅgānyuktāni sūribhiḥ || 68 || udyadraviprakarasannibhamacyutāṅke svāsīnamasya nutinityavacaḥpravṛttim | dhyāyedgadābhayakaraṃ sṛkṛtāñjaliṃ taṃ prāṇaṃ yatheṣṭatanumunnatakarmaśaktim||69|| prāṇādyāḥ pañcamāntrāśca tasye devasya vācakāḥ | ucyate harirapyetaiḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇādikaḥ || 70 ||
